name: zsh-config
description: The owner's zsh setup from a prebuilt zsh-portable dev bundle: static zsh, rendered dotfiles, pre-cloned plugins and theme, and bundled tools, installed into the remote user's home. No toolchains or caches.

version.description: latest = the rolling bundles release; else a release tag (bundle-dev-...).

bundleUrl.description: Override the bundle URL (mirrors, offline, tests); SHA256SUMS is read from the same directory.

defaultShell.description: Make zsh the remote user's login shell.
